She is entitled to come on from this run, but is certainly worth a market check.

That was his 12th career success over hurdles and on the Flat, including two on the level at this venue. Stuntman Steve was just over three lengths behind Lord Erskine in fifth at Fairyhouse, but could get closer on this better ground. Shraheen is appreciably up in class, but has more than earned a crack at this contest as he's on a hat-trick after victories at Tipperary and Leopardstown. The downside is that he has been off since Christmas. Raydamann's third in a big field at Punchestown was a more than fair effort.

Hattal is an expensive purchase, but this is a bit poorer race than you'd expect her to make her debut in and a hood first-time out does not inspire confidence. All that said, she must have been a nice type when she was purchased.

A chance is taken with MUY MUY LOCO who ran quite well here last time and would have been closer but for interfernce late on. Dangers abound, not least Banksman who was well backed when disappointing last time. He is very hard to fancy on his form, but that market move suggested those at home had seen something we are yet to see on the racecourse. Scenario is also a threat having run well last time on his handicap debut.

Furthermore the way she travelled that day suggested that this drop back in trip would do her no harm. Progressive top weight Prince Imperial is feared most despite his winning run coming to an end last time in a strong race. Bottom weight Bannister is also interesting at potentially generous odds. He is a course winner and was far from disgraced on his reappearance where he shaped as if this step up in trip would be of benefit.

Veteran Buxted Reel snapped a long losing run on his last flat outing and is open to improvement now handicapping in this sphere.

selections.comment: Ontheropes is the class angle here having proved he retained most of his ability over the winter. He was let down by his jumping last time where he found the ground too quick and holds strong claims if some rain arrives. If conditions stay as they are BUGS MORAN may be the answer. He is another who has had jumping issues since returning to rules after a point win but he was a very useful hurdler at his best so likely has more to offer in this sphere. Bartlemy Boy was prolific in points and did well to win on his rules debut given his rider dropped his whip late. He can fight for a place up in grade.

None of his rivals have got anywhere close to that level of form and his sole danger may come from Additional Time on its debut. He was a point winner and comes from a yard which has enjoyed succcess in this sphere.
